Mutations in IMPDH1 (causing MONDO:0013454) and ATIC (causing AICA-ribosiduria) both disrupt the purine biosynthesis pathway. IMPDH1 catalyzes the conversion of XMP to GMP, a critical step. Defects in this shared pathway can lead to downstream effects on nucleotide availability, impacting cellular processes and ultimately manifesting as neurodevelopmental phenotypes.

partners.mechanism_chain: IMPDH1 (HGNC:5350) —DECREASES→ GTP (CHEBI:16985); GTP (CHEBI:16985) —DECREASES→ Purine biosynthesis (GO:0006152); Purine biosynthesis (GO:0006152) —LEADS_TO→ Ocular abnormalities (HP:0000540); IFNGR1 (HGNC:5215) —DISRUPTS→ IFN-gamma signaling pathway (GO:0060661); IFN-gamma signaling pathway (GO:0060661) —LEADS_TO→ Susceptibility to mycobacterial infections (HP:0002713); IMPDH1 (HGNC:5350) —DECREASES→ IFN-gamma signaling pathway (GO:0060661).
